mapper.select: SELECT id, label, field_type, options_json, required FROM custom_field_definition WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND entity_type = #{entityType} AND archived = FALSE ORDER BY position, id
SELECT FROM custom_field_definition WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id}
SELECT FROM custom_field_definition WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND entity_type = #{entityType} AND field_key = #{fieldKey}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO custom_field_definition (workspace_id, entity_type, field_key, label, field_type, data_classification, options_json, required, position, archived) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{entityType}, #{fieldKey}, #{label}, #{fieldType}, COALESCE(#{dataClassification}, 'standard'), #{optionsJson}, #{required}, #{position}, #{archived})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM custom_field_definition WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id}
